news.summary: Verizon Communications Inc. is in talks to buy the broadband operator Fidium in a $6 billion deal, the Financial Times reported, a move that would expand its network and allow the mobile giant to target more internet service subscribers across the US.

news.title: Poland Signs $300 Million Palantir Deal to Use AI in Defense
news.summary: Poland will use artificial intelligence-based software from Palantir Technologies Inc. to analyze battlefield data, bucking a push by some European allies to reduce their reliance on US technology for critical defense capabilities.

news.summary: Hackers breached the US Air Force’s flagship cloud infrastructure, called Cloud One, potentially putting large amounts of sensitive tactical and personnel data at risk, Reuters reported on Friday.

news.title: AI Data-Center Developer LIAN Picks London for $500 Million IPO

news.title: Fed's Dec. Meeting May Mark Turning Point for Markets: Economist
